full_judgment: 2. The plaintiff-petitioner filed the aforesaid suit for declaration of title and recovery of Khas possession in respect of 244 square feet of land of the allegation, inter alia, that the defendant who is the owner of 22 kathas of land adjacent to the eastern side of the plaintiff encroached and occupied part of the plaintiff's land. The parties having failed to decide the dispute by mural agreement the suit was filed.
